Name: Tox's Troodon Ostrich
Author: toxicToxophilite
Description:
This troodon might very well be smarter than you are, but it's no fool. Free room, free board, free food, free friends, free pets? it'll play the role of passive pet for you for all those benefits, no problem. Might get a little bitey, but that just means "I love you" in dinosaur.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BKGNt0C.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/DQ94T8D.gif[/img]

Adult sprite heavily referenced from: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10273?tab=description]Sav's Raptors
[/url]Baby sprite heavily referenced from: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7614]Jekk's Ostrich Reskin

[/url]If someone would like to provide recolors, I will happily add them to the available files. In-game screenshots also welcome, as I have not unlocked ostriches yet!
